existing21title_catalog_screening: No exact topic duplicate in recovered21-title collection; not a fresh verification of every published post. Lake Nyos is scientifically distinct from Lake Peigneur but repeats a lake/disaster wrapper, so review novelty.

options.question: Pinatubo erupted in1991. Why did towns keep getting buried afterward?
options.mechanism: Rain-driven remobilization of volcanic deposits into lahars.
options.scientific_boundary: Historical geography/dates and deposits need exact source selection; no new-eruption implication or current warning.

options.question: How did solid-looking ground lose its support during the1990Luzon earthquake?
options.mechanism: Dagupan: susceptible saturated sand, pore-water pressure and reduced effective stress.
options.scientific_boundary: Not all soil liquefies; distinguish loss of support from melting and preserve drainage/saturation conditions.

options.question: During a Philippine typhoon, how can wind push the sea onto land?
options.mechanism: Wind-driven coastal water accumulation with pressure, bathymetry/tide context.
options.scientific_boundary: Separate surge,tide,rain flooding and waves; no invented event-specific water height or current warning.

options.question: How can solid rock flow without melting?
options.mechanism: Time-dependent deformation of largely solid mantle.
options.scientific_boundary: State geologic timescale; mantle not uniformly liquid, local partial melt is a separate condition.

options.question: Why do lunar spectra suggest rust on an airless Moon?
options.mechanism: Hematite spectral evidence versus difficult oxidizing conditions.
options.scientific_boundary: Observation and proposed Earth-oxygen/water pathways remain distinct; no claim the whole Moon is visibly rusting.

options.question: How can a lake release a deadly gas cloud without a new eruption?
options.mechanism: Lake Nyos: stored dissolvedCO2and rapid gas release.
options.scientific_boundary: Keep trigger uncertainty; no generalized danger claim about ordinary lakes; no new present-day risk estimate.

design_confound: Three local choices are geophysical hazards while universals span geology,space and hazard. Balance stakes/familiarity/production complexity during selection or explicitly retain this confound; not a pure test of geography.
